notes.title: Celebrating 1 month of release!
notes.notes:
Hello, explorers!
It's already been a month since early access release of our "Blink Planets".
To celebrate the monthsary, we're going to briefly share our news!

Today is also Valentine's Day, right?
Our "Bee" is also wandering in the sweet universe during the anniversary.
We hope you have a sweet day like "Bee"!

Before releasing "Blink Planets", We were very worried about whether people would be interested in, and also enjoy our games.

We'd like to thank everyone who paid more attention than our worries and gave us a lot of feedback. :)
Thanks to this, we are happily continuing our next work these days.
Especially in March, preparations for the first update are in full swing.
Representative contents to be updated are as follows.

 

1. The second planet with new rules and modules.
https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1836908865634672642/FF85D306CF0B7F6439C707D5C6D5436393D6FCFD/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false
"Aren't you curious about what the new planet will look like?"


https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1836908865634676429/1FA75B9A90ECB0AE1F6A8AB58CAF6202C6E27395/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false 
"We are creating new rules and modules to give more fun.
Based on this, new planet and stages will be ready soon."



2. Added diverse, active objects.
https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1836908865634677499/FBE8ACEE1788FA05F5E1A091BDB2422013D9834F/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false
"We are working in various ways by subdividing the grade of the base article.
Not only the game becomes more fun, but your eyes will also enjoy the colorful harmony."


If you have any opinions you'd like to reflect on our updates, 
please feel free to leave them on the Steam Community discussion page!
We will happily accept and review all opinions.

Then, we will work hard for a more fun game and bring more news soon!
Have fun every day with "Blink Planets"!
